items.title: Next Forcing: Causal World Modeling with Multi-Chunk Prediction
items.summary: Next Forcing introduces a multi-chunk prediction framework that accelerates training and inference for autoregressive video generation while improving accuracy and physical law adherence.

items.title: WorldOlympiad: Can Your World Model Survive a Triathlon?
items.summary: WorldOlympiad presents a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating video-based world models across physical faithfulness, geometric consistency, and interaction fidelity, revealing significant gaps in current generative models' capabilities.

items.title: The Role of Feedback Alignment in Self-Distillation
items.summary: Self-distillation effectiveness depends on structural alignment between feedback and solver reasoning, with step-aligned critique outperforming binary rewards and reference solutions by targeting specific reasoning failures.

items.title: FadeMem: Distance-Aware Memory Consolidation for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
items.summary: FadeMem introduces a distance-aware key-value memory consolidation mechanism that organizes historical video data into a temporal hierarchy, improving long-video generation by preserving recent context and long-range anchors under fixed cache constraints.

items.title: Interpreting and Steering a Text-to-Speech Language Model with Sparse Autoencoders
items.summary: Sparse autoencoders trained on language model representations reveal interpretable features for speech synthesis that can be manipulated to control linguistic and prosodic attributes.

items.title: UniPET: a universal network for high-quality PET image denoising across varied dose reduction factors
items.summary: A universal PET image denoising framework addresses variability in dose reduction factors through domain generalization techniques and region-aware learning strategies.

items.title: U-TTT: Towards Generalizable PET Image Denoising via Test-Time Training
items.summary: A novel U-shaped deep learning model with test-time training layers and dual-domain adaptation mechanisms achieves robust PET image denoising under distribution shifts.

items.title: Role-Agent: Bootstrapping LLM Agents via Dual-Role Evolution
items.summary: Role-Agent framework enables LLM agents to function as both agent and environment through bootstrapped co-evolution, improving performance via environment-aware reasoning and targeted practice.

items.title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
items.summary: MemDreamer addresses long-video understanding challenges by decoupling perception and reasoning through hierarchical graph memory and agentic exploration, achieving state-of-the-art performance with reduced computational overhead.

items.title: Retrospective Harness Optimization: Improving LLM Agents via Self-Preference over Trajectory Rollouts
items.summary: Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO) is a self-supervised method that improves AI agent performance by optimizing agent harness using only past trajectories through diverse task selection, parallel re-solving, and self-validation techniques.

items.title: Attention Amnesia in Hybrid LLMs: When CoT Fine-Tuning Breaks Long-Range Recall, and How to Fix It
items.summary: Chain-of-thought supervised fine-tuning degrades long-context recall in hybrid linear-attention models by biasing attention gradients toward short-range patterns, but a training-free method called QK-Restore can restore long-context capabilities by reverting query-key projections while preserving reasoning performance.

items.title: SearchSwarm: Towards Delegation Intelligence in Agentic LLMs for Long-Horizon Deep Research
items.summary: A large language model trained on synthesized delegation intelligence achieves superior performance on long-horizon research tasks through task decomposition and subagent coordination.

items.title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
items.summary: FlowTracer is an RL framework that uses attention-induced graphs to trace reasoning flows and assign token-level credit based on global information propagation structures.

items.title: When the Chain of Thought Knows Better: Failure Modes in Multi-Turn Reasoning Models
items.summary: Multi-turn reasoning models exhibit hidden alignment failures that are masked by traditional evaluation methods, revealing vulnerabilities through a trace-level diagnostic framework that identifies distinct failure modes including context-injection failures.

items.title: Emergent Misalignment Can Be Induced by Sycophancy and Reversed via Alignment Gating
items.summary: Sycophancy fine-tuning contributes to emergent misalignment in language models, which can be reversed using Alignment Gating—a method that inserts learnable gates to identify and control unsafe responses while maintaining general capabilities.

items.title: ARM: An AutoRegressive Large Multimodal Model with Unified Discrete Representations
items.summary: ARM demonstrates a unified autoregressive framework for image understanding, generation, and editing through discrete semantic tokenization and reinforcement learning optimization.

items.title: Dynamic Linear Attention
items.summary: DLA addresses limitations in long-context LLMs by introducing adaptive state merging and capacity-bounded memory modeling for improved multi-state linear attention.

items.title: Workflow-GYM: Towards Long-Horizon Evaluation of Computer-use Agentic tasks in Real-World Professional Fields
items.summary: Current AI agents struggle with long-horizon professional GUI workflows, achieving low success rates due to issues with workflow consistency and domain-specific software understanding.

items.title: MilliVid: Hierarchical Latents for Long-Range Consistency in Video Generation
items.summary: Video generative models achieve improved long-range consistency through coarse-to-fine token generation using a multi-scale autoencoder and diffusion model architecture.

items.title: VoLo: A Physical Orchestrator for Open-Vocabulary Long-Horizon Manipulation
items.summary: VoLoAgent enables physical orchestration by integrating vision-language models with robot capabilities for open-vocabulary long-horizon manipulation tasks.

items.title: Trust Functions: Near-Lossless Weak-to-Strong Generalization by Learning When to Trust the Weak Teacher
items.summary: Trust functions enable effective weak-to-strong generalization by identifying reliable weak labels for training, achieving performance comparable to ground-truth supervision across multiple domains.

items.title: Agents' Last Exam
items.summary: Agents' Last Exam (ALE) is a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on long-term, economically valuable real-world tasks across 13 industry clusters with 1K+ tasks, revealing significant gaps between benchmark performance and practical deployment.

items.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
items.summary: WIZARD is a weight-space meta-learning framework that generates task-specific LoRA parameters for frozen VLA policies using language instructions and demonstration videos, enabling efficient task adaptation without fine-tuning.

items.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
items.summary: A systematic framework converts mixture-of-experts models into dense architectures through expert scoring, selection, grouping, and knowledge distillation, achieving superior performance and efficiency compared to traditional pruning methods.

items.title: PsychoSafe: Eliciting Psychologically-Informed Refusals in Large Language Models
items.summary: A psychologically-informed refusal framework called PsychoSafe is developed for large language models to improve harmful request handling through structured supportive communication, showing enhanced refusal quality and resource referral while maintaining performance on non-refusal tasks.

items.title: Late-Layer Fusion is Enough: Dual-Path Vision Token Routing for Multimodal Large Language Models under Visual Saturation
items.summary: Research reveals that vision and text tokens in multimodal models evolve asynchronously, leading to inefficient computation; a new asymmetric routing framework reduces visual processing overhead while maintaining performance.

items.title: Lip Forcing: Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion for Real-time Lip Synchronization
items.summary: Autoregressive diffusion method for video-to-video lip synchronization achieves real-time performance through distillation and optimized inference schedules.

items.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
items.summary: Flow-DPPO replaces ratio clipping with divergence proximal constraints in flow matching models, improving training stability and multi-objective optimization through exact KL divergence computation.

items.title: Rethinking the Divergence Regularization in LLM RL
items.summary: DRPO improves LLM reinforcement learning stability by replacing hard masks with smooth regularization that provides continuous gradient corrections beyond trust-region boundaries.

items.title: EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents
items.summary: EEVEE is a novel test-time prompt learning framework for LLM agents that handles heterogeneous data streams through task clustering and co-evolving router-prompt optimization.

items.title: Struct-Searcher: Agentic Structural Thinking Advances Multimodal Deep Information Seeking
items.summary: Struct-Searcher introduces a belief revision theory-based structural agentic workflow for multimodal information seeking that improves accuracy over existing vision-language models and deep research agents.

items.title: Bridging the Agent-World Gap: Text World Models for LLM-based Agents
items.summary: Text world models serve as transition models for LLM-based agents in interactive environments, enabling planning and efficient learning by predicting environmental changes from textual states and actions.

items.title: Test-Time Gradient Guidance of Flow Policies in Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: QGF is an RL algorithm that improves policies at test time by using a value gradient to guide a pre-trained flow policy, avoiding training-time instability while maintaining competitive performance.

items.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model
items.summary: ABot-Earth 0.5 generates realistic 3D environments from satellite imagery using 3D Gaussian Splatting representation, enabling fast synthesis and real-time visualization for Embodied AI applications.

items.title: Online Skill Learning for Web Agents via State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval
items.summary: State-Grounded Dynamic Retrieval enables web agents to dynamically reuse skills based on current webpage state rather than fixed task-level strategies, improving automation performance across multiple domains.

items.title: What Should Agents Say? Action-state Communication for Efficient Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Multi-agent systems using large language models suffer from inefficient token consumption in agent-to-agent communication, which PACT addresses by structuring messages as compact action-state records that improve performance-cost trade-offs across different system architectures.

items.title: Send a SCOUT First: Pre-hoc Reasoning for Adaptive Detector Allocation in Prompt-Injection Defense
items.summary: SCOUT framework dynamically allocates prompt-injection detection by predicting detector reliability and latency, improving safety and efficiency over fixed single-detector approaches.

items.title: AsyncWebRL: Efficient Multi-Step RL for Visual Web Agents
items.summary: AsyncWebRL improves vision-language web agent training through asynchronous reinforcement learning and trajectory normalization modifications, achieving faster throughput and better performance on challenging tasks.

items.title: Light-WAM: Efficient World Action Models with State-Fusion Action Decoding
items.summary: Light-WAM is a lightweight world action model for robot manipulation that uses a compact video backbone and downsampled latent space for efficient future-video supervision, combined with a StateFusionActionExpert for direct action prediction.

items.title: SDR: Set-Distance Rewards for Radiology Report Generation
items.summary: Set-based rewards using embedding distances improve chest X-ray report generation by enabling effective post-training and test-time selection without requiring causal reasoning structures.

items.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
items.summary: SigmaScale learns auxiliary scaling matrices to improve truncated SVD-based LLM compression by adapting to individual weight structures through activation-aware transformations.

items.title: DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search
items.summary: A distributed Quality-Diversity search framework uses heterogeneous large language models as mutation operators to enhance evolutionary inference, demonstrating that model diversity improves performance over homogeneous parallel approaches.

items.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
items.summary: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B is an open-source Mixture-of-Experts multimodal foundation model that enables long-video understanding and agentic intelligence through DeepSeek Sparse Attention and specialized training infrastructure.

items.title: IR3DE: A Linear Router for Large Language Models
items.summary: A ridge regression-based routing method achieves competitive performance in selecting domain-expert LLMs for different tasks while enabling dynamic addition/removal of experts without retraining.

items.title: BrainSurgery: Reproducible and Reliable Declarative Weight Manipulations for Model Editing and Upcycling
items.summary: BrainSurgery is a tool for robust and reproducible tensor manipulation of neural network checkpoints through declarative YAML plans with built-in validation.

items.title: Data Journalist Agent: Transforming Data into Verifiable Multimodal Stories
items.summary: A multi-agent framework automates data journalism by generating evidence-grounded, multimodal news stories while maintaining transparency and verifiability.

items.title: One Token per Multimodal Evidence: Latent Memory for Resource-Constrained QA
items.summary: Latent Memory introduces a compressed representation approach for external memory in question answering, reducing token consumption and storage requirements while maintaining competitive performance across text-only and multimodal benchmarks.

items.title: SCAIL-2: Unifying Controlled Character Animation with End-to-end In-Context Conditioning
items.summary: SCAIL-2 enables end-to-end character animation by directly transferring motion from driving videos without intermediate representations, using unified task decomposition and synthetic data generation.

items.title: BenSyc: Benchmarking Conversational Sycophancy and Human Alignment in LLMs for Bengali Contexts
items.summary: Researchers create BenSyc, a benchmark for evaluating conversational sycophancy in Bengali contexts, revealing challenges in distinguishing empathetic support from validation and escalation in emotionally sensitive dialogues.

items.title: Precision Is Not Faithfulness: Coverage-Aware Evaluation of Grounded Generation with a Complete Oracle
items.summary: Reference-free faithfulness metrics suffer from a blind spot measuring only precision, leading to rewards for abstention; completeness in deterministic domains enables measurement of both precision and recall, revealing that high-precision models often have poor fact coverage.
